job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

WHO IS INFRATECH SOLUTIONS?
Founded in 2023, InfraTech Solutions combines the agility of a startup with the robust resources of our parent company, Objective Paradigm. Built to support the rapidly growing infrastructure space, we specialize in delivering top-tier IT talent to companies looking to close critical technology gaps. Headquartered in the tri-state area, we have become a trusted partner for firms ranging from high-growth startups to Fortune 100 enterprises. Our team of highly specialized recruiters brings 14+ years of expertise in the IT infrastructure market, navigating diverse landscapes to connect top talent with cutting-edge organizations.
THE OPPORTUNITY:
We’re expanding our team and looking for a driven Account Executive to join our growing team of experts. You’ll report to our Practice Lead and focus primarily on infrastructure contract staffing, working closely with our recruiting team to deliver high-impact IT talent to top-tier clients.
We provide hands-on training, mentorship, and a proven playbook to help you succeed. You’ll become a subject matter expert in highly sought-after IT roles, helping companies secure top talent while growing your own book of business.
Are you the right fit?
 You thrive in fast-paced environments and love working with clients ranging from boutique tech firms to global financial services companies.
 You’re eager to build and expand client relationships, ensuring a seamless hiring experience.
 You want to be a true consultant, understanding client needs and delivering talent solutions that make an impact.
 You’re motivated by growth, autonomy, and the opportunity to build something big.
At InfraTech, we take pride in our high-touch, consultative approach, ensuring that our clients get the best talent, and our consultants feel fully supported throughout their engagements.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
 Develop and execute sales strategies to secure new business opportunities through internal leads, referrals, networking events, job postings, and industry connections.
 Identify and qualify staffing and project-based opportunities, working closely with clients to understand their IT hiring needs.
 Build and manage relationships with key decision-makers, including HR, Procurement, and hiring managers.
 Partner with our Recruiting Team to match top IT professionals with contract and consulting opportunities.
 Own the sales cycle, from identifying opportunities to negotiating contracts and closing deals.
 Stay ahead of industry trends by attending tech events, user groups, and networking functions.
 Leverage our CRM to track your sales pipeline, manage relationships, and drive long-term growth.
 Help shape the future of our business by contributing to strategic initiatives and process improvements.
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:
 2+ years of sales experience in IT staffing, recruitment, or consulting services.
 A hunter mentality—you love breaking into new accounts and growing revenue.
 Proven ability to manage accounts, build relationships, and navigate complex hiring processes.
 Strong negotiation skills with a consultative approach to sales.
 Exceptional time management and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
 A competitive, results-driven mindset—you’re motivated by wins and thrive under pressure.
 Bonus: Experience scaling teams, mentoring, or leading sales initiatives.
WHY INFRATECH?
 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission! Your earning potential is in your hands.
 A "Do What’s Right" culture—we value integrity, teamwork, and transparency.
 Career growth opportunities—future leadership roles and a direct path to management.
 Flexibility & work-life balance—we support a hybrid work environment.
 Full benefits package—medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, PTO, onsite gym, and more.
 An established client base with more jobs than we can fill—you’ll hit the ground running.
 No suits required—we believe in a casual, collaborative work culture.
 A team of industry veterans who are here to mentor, support, and help you win.
READY TO LEVEL UP YOUR CAREER?
If you're looking for a dynamic, high-growth environment where you can build something special, let’s talk. Whether you’re a proven sales professional or an up-and-coming go-getter ready to make your mark, InfraTech Solutions has the platform to help you succeed.
 Apply now and let’s build something great together!

job.description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Location: New York, NY (Hybrid: 3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

Position Type: Contract-to-Hire

About the Opportunity

Are you looking to build transformative software at the intersection of modern artificial intelligence and digital learning platforms? We are seeking an experienced Full Stack AI Engineer to drive the creation of intelligent applications, automated workflows, and robust cloud services. In this dynamic contract-to-hire role, you will play a central part in modernizing educational technology solutions while delivering seamless user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy end-to-end web applications and internal tools empowered by artificial intelligence.

  • Construct modular backend architectures, data management pipelines, and business logic utilizing Node.js or Python.

  • Establish seamless connections between core educational administrative platforms, learning management environments, and third-party tools.

  • Design and publish reliable RESTful endpoints, GraphQL interfaces, and event-triggered webhooks.

  • Automate academic and engagement processes through smart, data-driven analytical workflows.

  • Orchestrate event-based processing systems and construct scalable serverless functions across major cloud providers.

  • Enforce robust security practices, including token-based authentication protocols, single sign-on (SSO), and strict student data privacy regulations.

  • Work alongside cross-functional engineering and infrastructure teams to launch enterprise-grade cloud solutions.

Requirements (must-have)

  • 5+ years of software engineering expertise focused on full-stack development, API creation, or process automation.

  • Proven hands-on development experience in backend engineering using Python or Node.js.

  • Background building software that integrates with core academic management systems and learning platforms.

  • Demonstrated expertise in developing APIs and managing data pipelines or ETL synchronization.

  • Proficiency with leading cloud infrastructure providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Firm grasp of identity and access standards, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, and IAM practices.

  • Strong analytical mind with exceptional technical communication and troubleshooting abilities.

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have)

  • Practical implementation of Large Language Models (LLMs) and automated intelligence tools.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React.

  • Background with messaging queues or pub/sub models (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis).

  • Understanding of containerization techniques (Docker) and serverless compute models.

  • Experience documenting and testing APIs via OpenAPI/Swagger and Postman.

  • Prior exposure to mission-oriented, educational, or non-profit tech environments.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Target Pay Rate: $140.00/hour

  • Hybrid work arrangement offering flexibility with remote Mondays and Fridays.

 

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

job.description:
Job Title: Detection & Response Engineering Manager

Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

About the Opportunity Are you ready to build and lead a modern threat detection and incident handling practice for a rapidly growing fintech enterprise? We are seeking a hands-on technical leader to mature our security operations, pioneer artificial intelligence integrations, and refine our threat infrastructure. In this role, you will mentor a dedicated engineering team while driving automated response strategies across a modern cloud ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Direct security monitoring, threat triage, and incident handling operations across multi-cloud infrastructure, endpoint assets, and SaaS environments.

  • Serve as operational escalation lead during security incidents and participate in the team's on-call rotation.

  • Oversee the end-to-end detection engineering lifecycle—authoring, tuning, and decommissioning rules mapped against the MITRE ATT&CK framework to minimize false positives.

  • Manage security data pipelines, ensuring proper ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and API-based telemetry routing.

  • Champion detection-as-code principles by shifting rules into version-controlled repositories backed by peer review and automated testing.

  • Design, architect, and deploy net-new detection platforms and response tools from initial proof-of-concept through production rollout.

  • Integrate automation and generative AI into security operations center workflows to streamline alert processing, orchestration, and triage.

  • Present metrics regarding incident trends, detection coverage, and overall program maturity to senior IT and security executives.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, threat detection engineering, or incident response.

  • Proven capability to break down strategic roadmaps into concrete deliverables and mentor technical team members (formal management tenure is not required).

  • Strong capability to author custom scripts and build detection logic using code-based frameworks.

  • Track record of taking security tools and architecture from initial design to full production deployment.

  • Technical expertise with modern cloud SIEM/SOAR platforms and telemetry collection from AWS environments.

  • Ability to define, track, and optimize operational KPIs, including mean time to respond (MTTR), false-positive rates, and detection coverage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, or specialized GIAC incident response titles.

  • Direct experience integrating AI models or large language models (LLMs) into security workflows.

  • Familiarity with AI-specific risk vectors, including prompt injection mechanics and agent trust boundaries.

  • Practical experience conducting threat-hunting campaigns or purple teaming exercises.

  • Background in regulated domains (such as financial services or fintech) with exposure to SOC 2, PCI DSS, or GLBA standards.

  • Experience securing cloud-native setups and containerized application deployments.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $150,000 – $180,000 USD annually, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance options.

  • Generous paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, and paid parental leave.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

  • Continuous training allowances, career development resources, and merit growth tracks.

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Job Title

Security Engineering Manager

About the Opportunity

Are you a hands-on technical leader ready to shape the defensive architecture of a modern, cloud-first infrastructure? We are seeking a Security Engineering Manager to guide a high-performing team of engineers while driving application security and cloud protection strategies across our modern software ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge strategic security vision with deep technical execution, empowering product and engineering teams to build fast without sacrificing security.

Responsibilities

  • Program Direction: Drive the continuous evolution of our application security and cloud posture initiatives throughout every stage of the software development lifecycle.

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and cultivate a dedicated team of security engineers, fostering a high-ownership culture focused on professional growth and technical rigor.

  • Strategic Delivery: Plan, track, and execute security engineering initiatives from design through deployment, guaranteeing alignment with broader organizational risk priorities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and DevOps leaders to embed preventative security standards directly into engineering roadmaps and development workflows.

  • Risk Reduction: Proactively identify infrastructure vulnerabilities, remove operational roadblocks, and maintain momentum on remediation efforts across all engineering domains.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing technical teams while successfully delivering complex security projects.

  • Deep technical mastery of secure software development practices, CI/CD pipeline protections, secrets administration, and application vulnerabilities.

  • Exceptional ability to translate high-level security frameworks into concrete engineering deliverables for both dedicated security staff and partner development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience configuring cloud-native security controls, including DSPM, CSPM, and workload protection solutions within AWS environments.

  • Familiarity with automated application scanning methodologies (SAST/DAST/SCA) and IaC deployment frameworks (e.g., Terraform, cloud automation suites).

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with performance-based incentive structures.

job.description:
Senior Wireless Network Engineer

Location: New York, NY
Schedule: Hybrid, 3 days onsite
Type: Contract to Hire
Start: ASAP

Overview

A growing organization is seeking a senior-level Wireless Network Engineer with strong hands-on Wi-Fi expertise.

This is not a traditional route/switch role. The focus is heavily on wireless troubleshooting, RF design, Meraki, and supporting a large, high-density multi-site environment.

The role is roughly 80% operational troubleshooting and 20% project work.

Must Haves

  • Strong Cisco Meraki wireless experience
  • Advanced Wi-Fi and RF troubleshooting
  • Cell sizing, radio profiles, power, channels, and AP placement
  • Experience with 5 GHz and 6 GHz environments
  • High-density wireless experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot independently
  • Strong communication and teamwork
  • Proactive, hands-on mindset

Environment

  • Cisco Meraki
  • Some Cisco enterprise wireless
  • Modern Wi-Fi environments, including newer wireless standards
  • Large multi-site footprint
  • High-density user environments
  • Continued location growth and expansion

What They Want

Someone who can walk into a difficult Wi-Fi issue, investigate independently, and identify the root cause.

The right person will also look beyond the immediate problem, identify improvements, document processes, and help mentor other technical team members.

Not a Fit

  • Generic route/switch engineers
  • Candidates with limited wireless depth
  • Candidates with no Meraki experience
  • Pure architects who are no longer hands-on

Some assignments may be recurring and scheduled, while others may be ad-hoc, event-based, or on-call depending on the needs of our clients. You’ll have the opportunity to work with modern collaboration technology and support everything from conference rooms and video conferencing to live events and webcasting.

job.title: DataCenter Estimator
job.description:
Data Center Estimator

Location: Paramus, NJ (On Site)
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a Data Center Estimator to join our growing team in Paramus, NJ. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on data center infrastructure experience who is looking to transition into an office-based estimating role.

This is not a traditional estimating position. Our estimators are responsible for developing complete project estimates, including labor, materials, bills of materials (BOMs), takeoffs, and scopes of work for mission critical data center infrastructure projects. Success in this role requires the ability to understand how a project will be built and accurately estimate every component required for installation.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate labor and material estimates for data center infrastructure projects.

  • Develop bills of materials (BOMs), material takeoffs, and detailed scopes of work.

  • Review drawings, layouts, and customer requirements to build complete project estimates.

  • Conduct site surveys and gather project information as needed.

  • Work closely with project managers, sales, and operations to ensure accurate project pricing.

  • Proofread estimates for accuracy before submission.

  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and other internal estimating tools to prepare proposals.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience installing or estimating data center infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of structured cabling, fiber optic and copper cabling systems.

  • Experience with ladder rack, cable tray, wire basket, strut/channel systems, server cabinets, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Ability to interpret drawings, Visio layouts, and project documentation.

  • Knowledge of labor estimating, material takeoffs, and bills of materials.

  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Bluebeam, SAP, and Visio is preferred.

  • Familiarity with industry estimating resources such as RSMeans, NECA, or similar is a plus.

  • Excellent attention to detail with strong written communication skills.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

  • Data center construction

  • Structured cabling

  • Fiber optic installation

  • Mission critical facilities

  • Commercial or industrial electrical contracting

  • Low voltage systems

Field installation experience is highly preferred. We have found the most successful estimators are individuals who understand how data center infrastructure is physically built and can translate that experience into accurate estimates.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to work on complex, high-profile data center infrastructure projects with a company that specializes in mission critical environments. If you enjoy solving technical problems, have a strong understanding of data center construction, and are looking to grow your career in estimating, we'd like to hear from you.

 

 **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**
